findings.cause: Concurrent admissions checked the limit before awaiting native preflight; raw follow_up bypassed it.
findings.fix: Serialize admissions and reserve capacity before await; enforce a combined 16-input cap.
checks: raw follow_up cannot bypass queue cap

findings.cause: A finishing agent could settle during awaited input preflight and leave an accepted input orphaned.
findings.fix: Use the public Pi before-settle hook to wait for accepted preflight; include in-flight work in state and emit actual settlement.
checks: end-of-turn preflight is consumed exactly once; no idle orphan

findings.cause: Clearing once before abort allowed delayed preflight to repopulate the queue; concurrent aborts could reopen the stopping gate early.
findings.fix: Invalidate admissions by epoch, share one abort promise, drain preflight and clear again before reopening.
checks: concurrent abort keeps stopping gate closed

findings.cause: Native handled was treated as rejection despite a successful extension input handler.
findings.fix: Accept handled without enqueue/replay, log it separately; only not_running queues a new task.

findings.cause: Input still downloading an attachment could be enqueued and executed after /stop.
findings.fix: Capture the channel/reset epoch before download and recheck before compaction interruption and under admission lock.

findings.cause: The 10-second steer timeout excluded a blocked send/write-lock/drain.
findings.fix: Apply the same timeout to both send and reply; keep ambiguous outcomes explicit and never auto-replay.

findings.cause: Subsequent callback handoff metadata contained only the initial task, omitting accepted owner corrections.
findings.fix: Append accepted corrections to the bounded per-turn handoff consumed by Codex arm_callback; preserve original head and latest tail.

findings.cause: Help described abort-on-message; wait description promised immediate interruption although ordinary corrections now steer.
findings.fix: Help and wait description now state boundary injection and distinguish explicit /stop.

findings.cause: Attachments after the first two were silently ignored.
findings.fix: Reject the whole request with an explicit two-attachment limit before downloading or steering.

findings.cause: Explicit new/model/reset removed sessions without updating the status snapshot or logging that reset.
findings.fix: Refresh the status after removing sessions and log only channel plus command.

coverage.1_admission: Normal active same-channel owner input sends steer(timeout=10, onlyIfActive=true). queued/handled are native Pi dispositions; onlyIfActive/not_running are wrapper-level. not_running enqueues once without stopping a finishing turn; background/compacting work intentionally uses stop+enqueue. Ambiguous timeout never auto-replays.
coverage.2_injection_boundary: Actual scripted streaming and tool fixtures verified the in-flight provider request stays unchanged; addenda enter the next model call exactly once. No token-level live steering is wired.
coverage.3_state: queuedMessageCount equals native pendingMessageCount. isSettled additionally requires no pending input preflight, native queue, host jobs, compaction, active run or stop. Python wait_until_settled/reusable_after_error consume the same fields.
coverage.4_abort: Epoch-invalidated pending ingress, serialized native queue edits, shared abort completion and post-preflight clear prevent late-input leakage. Discord /stop invalidates both enqueued fallback and still-downloading input.
coverage.5_modes_and_cap: Explicit steeringMode=all combines corrections at one boundary; followUpMode=one-at-a-time preserves follow-up order. Combined steer/follow_up admission capacity=16, with explicit Korean queue-full guidance.
coverage.6_validation: Actual gateway image validation/conversion reaches native provider image payload; >2 attachments rejected. Empty/non-string text, malformed image metadata and UTF-8 frames >1MiB rejected. 40k Hangul text retained intact. Production disables skill/template discovery and extension commands; public fixture input hooks test handled/errors without modifying installed Pi.
coverage.7_deployment: Live sources equal repository bytes; all five prior pi-task after hashes matched the initial live baseline. Current runner executable bind-mount hash equals deployed hash and belongs to evo-bot cgroup. No audited /opt/evo-omp references or old deployment paths found. Each maintenance restart verified byte-identical transcript prefix recovery.
coverage.8_evidence: No genuine owner_input_steered or 10s timeout events observed in the scanned service journal. Actual production Bot.on_message -> bwrap -> installed Pi path verified with captured Discord sends and a scripted local provider; its admission events are test events, not journal proof of genuine owner steering.
